documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sacheerome Limited reported an exceptional performance for FY26, characterized by robust revenue growth, improved profitability, and expanded operating margins. Management highlighted strong demand across core end-markets like FMCG, personal care, and food and beverages, which supports their long-term growth outlook. The company is actively investing in manufacturing infrastructure, notably a new plant in YEIDA, Uttar Pradesh, to scale production capacities. Backed by a strengthened balance sheet, healthy cash flows, and a seasoned leadership team, the company remains positioned to capitalize on industry tailwinds. Sacheerome Limited reported a strong performance in H1 FY26, with revenue from operations growing 51.75% to Rs.

guidance.claim: The company hopes to perform as well as the first half or slightly better in the full year FY26.
guidance.quote: We are at the end of the second month of the third quarter. Okay? So, we are doing equally good and we hope to perform as good as the first half or even a little better.

guidance.claim: Revenue from the new facility is expected to start coming in from the first quarter of the next financial year.
guidance.quote: From the first quarter of the next financial year, the revenue will start coming from the new facility also.

demand_outlook.claim: The fragrance and flavour industry continues to experience strong demand driven by consumption in FMCG, food and beverage, and personal care segments.
demand_outlook.quote: The fragrance and flavour industry continues to witness strong demand supported by growing consumption across FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care categories.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced strong performance driven by healthy demand across different product categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We delivered a strong performance, driven by healthy demand across different product categories, and with the enhanced product range.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand has been resilient across all categories, supporting robust revenue growth.
demand_outlook.quote: This performance underlines the strength of market positioning, the resilience of demand across all categories, and the effectiveness of our customer engagement strategy.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian consumers are demanding better quality products, which is driving the need for higher quality offerings.
demand_outlook.quote: This is the demand of the Indian consumers that they want a better quality product and it is not that we have increased the price, but yes, India is looking for the better quality products and we have to give the products as per the requirement of the customers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company started construction of a new factory unit in YEIDA in 2023.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of new factory unit in YEIDA started 2023

capex_expansion.claim: Sacheerome acquired land in YEIDA in 2020 for establishing a new manufacturing unit.
capex_expansion.quote: Allotment of Land in YEIDA for the purpose of establishment of new manufacturing unit 2020

capex_expansion.claim: Civil construction of the upcoming facility at Yamuna Express Industrial Development Area is nearly complete.
capex_expansion.quote: As the first half of FY26, we have nearly completed the civil construction of our upcoming facility at Yamuna Express Industrial Development Area.

capex_expansion.claim: The new facility is expected to be fully operational in Q4 of FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: We remain on track to bring the new facility in full operations in Q4 of FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming facility is being built on 21,023 square meters of land and will feature two towers.
capex_expansion.quote: This facility is being built on a land area of 21,023 sq. mtrs. and will comprise of two towers, with one tower dedicated to fragrances and the other two flavors.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capex required for the new facility is approximately Rs. 184.16 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total facility is approximately Rs.184.16 crores and we are going on the track and we are making the good progress.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has invested Rs. 53.64 crores into the YEIDA facility as of the first half of FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: As on first half of FY26, we have invested Rs.53.64 crores of funds into the YEIDA facility.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 was marked by strong growth across revenue, profitability, and operational performance alongside superior margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: “FY26 has been an exceptional year for Sacheerome marked by strong growth across revenue, profitability, and operational performance. Our ability to deliver superior margin expansion alongside robust revenue growth reflects the strength of our business model, product portfolio, and execution capabilities.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded to 26.98% in H1 FY26 due to improved operating leverage and disciplined cost management.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded significantly to 26.98% from 20.22% in the same period last year, reflecting improved operating leverage and disciplined cost management.

margins_costs.claim: The company believes its margin expansion is sustainable due to operational efficiency, disciplined cost control, and a strong pricing strategy.
margins_costs.quote: And we believe our margin expansion is sustainable due to a combination of factors -- higher proportion of high margin products, operational efficiency, disciplined cost control and a strong pricing strategy.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current capacity is 7,60,000 kilos, and the new capacity will add another 20 lakh kilos.
orders_capacity.quote: So, as you are aware, our current capacity is 7,60,000 kilos and in the new capacity, we are doing adding another 20 lakh kilos which will make our total capacity to 27,60,000 kilos.

orders_capacity.claim: The new capacity will be almost five times the current capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: And our new capacity will have 5x (almost) than the current capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expects almost more than 100% utilization for FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: The company invested Rs. 7.07 crores from IPO proceeds and Rs. 46.57 crores from internal accruals into the YEIDA facility.
capital_allocation.quote: The funds invested from the IPO proceeds amounts to Rs.7.07 crores and from internal accrual amounts to Rs.46.57 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a term loan from HDFC Bank to cover its funding needs.
capital_allocation.quote: We have the term loan from HDFC Bank and we are fully covered.

capital_allocation.claim: The term loan from HDFC Bank is around Rs. 60 crores.
Working capital cycle was optimized to about 23 days compared to 45 days in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: One of the examples could be how we were able to optimize our working capital cycle as well which we have been able to operate at about 23-days compared to 45-days which we were doing in previous year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainties including macroeconomic trends, currency fluctuations, interest rates, and regulatory changes that could cause actual results to differ materially.
risks_headwinds.quote: While these forward looking statements indicate our assessment and future expectations concerning the development of our business, a number of risks, uncertainties and other unknown factors could cause actual developments and results to differ materially from our expectations . These factors include, but are not limited to, general market, macro economic, governmental and regulatory trends, movements in currency exchange and interest rates, competitive pressures, technological developments, changes in the financial conditions of third parties dealing with us, legislative developments, and other key factors that could affect our business and financial performance .

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry has faced turbulences such as a fire in BSF, COVID, China products, and scarcity due to climatic conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: There are three turbulences we have faced, everybody in the industry, not only we. First of all, there was a fire in BSF, then there was COVID, then, China products, and sometimes, due to the climatic conditions, due to some reasons, there is scarcity.

risks_headwinds.claim: Some competitive pressures exist in the market.
risks_headwinds.quote: While some competitive pressures exist, our value-added offerings and differentiated solutions allow us to maintain the healthy margins.

management_commitments.claim: The company is on track to bring the new facility into full operations in Q4 of FY26.
management_commitments.quote: We remain on track to bring the new facility in full operations in Q4 of FY26.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue will start coming from the new facility from the first quarter of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: From the first quarter of the next financial year, the revenue will start coming from the new facility also.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects almost more than 100% capacity utilization in FY27.
